info.title: Calliope
info.description: The API of Calliope, a community of private writing groups.

post.summary: Register a user and start a session
post.description: Creates a user and immediately starts a session for them. The username and the email address must both be unused; the address is compared case-insensitively.

409.description: Username or email address already in use

post.summary: Log a user in and start a session
post.description: Exchanges a username or e-mail address and password for a session cookie. Answers the same way whether the username, e-mail address or the password was wrong.

post.summary: Log the current user out and end the session
post.description: Ends the session the request was made with and clears its cookie. Other sessions of the same user are left alone.

get.description: Reports who the session cookie belongs to. The session cookie is httpOnly, so this is the only way for a client to find out whether it is signed in and as whom.

post.description: Sends a link that sets a new password to the account's e-mail address. Takes a username or an e-mail address, like the login endpoint. Answers the same way whether or not an account matches, so it cannot be used to find out who is registered, and does the work after responding so the timing cannot either.

200.description: Request accepted, whether or not a message was sent

post.summary: Set a new password with a reset token
post.description: Spends the token from a reset link and sets a new password. The token works once and ends every existing session, so the member signs in again afterwards. No session is started here: the link may have been read by somebody else.

410.description: The link is unknown, already used, or expired

post.summary: Confirm an email address with a verification token
post.description: Spends the token from a verification link. Deliberately needs no session: the link is often opened in a different browser from the one that registered. No session is started either, for the same reason.

410.description: The link is unknown, already used, or expired

post.description: Reachable without a verified address, since it is how one is obtained. Answers the same way whether a message was sent or the resend cooldown swallowed it, and does nothing at all when the address is already verified.

200.description: Request accepted, whether or not a message was sent

patch.summary: Correct an address that has not been verified yet
patch.description: The escape hatch for an address mistyped at registration, which would otherwise orphan the account. Refuses once the address has been verified: changing a proven address has to notify the old one and offer an undo, or a stolen session could move the account to another inbox.

200.description: Address changed, and a new link sent to it

403.description: The address is already verified and cannot be changed here

409.description: Another account already uses this address

post.summary: Create a group, with the creating user as its administrator
post.description: Creates a writing group and joins the creating user to it as its administrator. Groups are private unless the request asks for a public one.

query.summary: List groups, by default the current user's own
query.description: Returns a page of groups, by default the ones the current user has joined. The membership filter selects invitations, public groups they are not in, or everything they may see instead.

membership.description: Which groups relative to the caller: ones they have joined, ones they have been invited to, public ones they are not in, or everything they may see.

get.summary: Fetch a public group, or a private one the user belongs to
get.description: Returns a single group. A private group the current user does not belong to is reported as missing rather than forbidden, so that its existence stays hidden.

404.description: No such group, or it is private and not the user's

patch.summary: Update a group the user administers
patch.description: Changes a group's title, description or visibility. Only an administrator of the group may do so, and only one who has joined it.

403.description: The user is not an administrator of the group

404.description: No such group, or it is private and not the user's

post.summary: Invite a user to a group the current user administers
post.description: Invites a user to the group with a role. The invitation always starts as such; only the invited user can turn it into a membership.

403.description: The user is not an administrator of the group

404.description: No such group, or no such user to invite

409.description: The user is already invited to or a member of the group

query.summary: List the memberships and invitations of a group
query.description: Returns a page of the group's memberships, including invitations that have not been accepted yet.

404.description: No such group, or it is private and not the user's

post.summary: Accept the current user's invitation to a group
post.description: Turns the current user's invitation into a membership. Only the invited user can accept, and only once.

404.description: The current user has no invitation to this group

409.description: The invitation has already been accepted

delete.summary: Leave a group, or decline its invitation
delete.description: Removes the current user's own membership, which also declines a pending invitation. Leaving as the last member deletes the group.

200.description: The membership or invitation was removed

404.description: The current user has no membership in this group

patch.summary: Change a member's role in a group the current user administers
patch.description: Changes a member's role. The status cannot be changed here: accepting an invitation is the invited user's to do.

403.description: The user is not an administrator of the group

404.description: No such group, or no such membership

delete.summary: Remove a member from a group the current user administers
delete.description: Removes a member or a pending invitation. Removing the last remaining member deletes the group along with it.

403.description: The user is not an administrator of the group

404.description: No such group, or no such membership

post.summary: Start a thread in a group the current user writes in
post.description: Starts a thread in the group. Writers and administrators may start threads; readers may not.

404.description: No such group, or the user is not a member of it

query.summary: List the threads of a group the current user belongs to
query.description: Returns a page of the group's threads. Readable by any joined member, whatever their role, and by nobody else.

404.description: No such group, or the user is not a member of it

get.summary: Fetch a thread of a group the current user belongs to
get.description: Returns a single thread of the group. A thread id belonging to another group is reported as missing.

404.description: No such group or thread, or the user is not a member

patch.summary: Rename a thread the current user wrote or administers
patch.description: Renames a thread. Only the member who started it, or an administrator of the group, may change it.

403.description: Only the author or an administrator may change it

404.description: No such group or thread, or the user is not a member

delete.summary: Delete a thread the current user wrote or administers
delete.description: Deletes a thread and every post in it. Only the member who started it, or an administrator of the group, may delete it.

200.description: The thread and its posts were deleted

403.description: Only the author or an administrator may delete it

404.description: No such group or thread, or the user is not a member

post.summary: Add a post to a thread in a group the current user writes in
post.description: Adds a post to the thread, either published or as a draft. Writers and administrators may write posts; readers may not.

404.description: No such group or thread, or the user is not a member

query.summary: List the posts of a thread, plus the current user's own drafts
query.description: Returns a page of the thread's published posts, plus the current user's own unpublished drafts. Other members' drafts are never included.

404.description: No such group or thread, or the user is not a member

get.summary: Fetch a post of a thread the current user can read
get.description: Returns a single post. Another member's unpublished draft is reported as missing, including to administrators.

404.description: No such post, or it is somebody else's unpublished draft

patch.summary: Edit or publish a post the current user wrote or administers
patch.description: Edits a post's text, or publishes a draft by clearing its draft flag. Only its author, or an administrator of the group, may change it.

403.description: Only the author or an administrator may change it

404.description: No such post, or it is somebody else's unpublished draft

delete.summary: Delete a post the current user wrote or administers
delete.description: Deletes a post. Only its author, or an administrator of the group, may delete it.

403.description: Only the author or an administrator may delete it

404.description: No such post, or it is somebody else's unpublished draft

get.summary: Report whether the application and its databases are usable
get.description: Reports the application's identity and uptime together with the reachability of every database it depends on. Answers without a session and is not rate limited, so it can be polled by a liveness probe.

200.description: Everything the application depends on is reachable

query.description: Returns a page of members, narrowed to those whose username contains the search term when one is given. Only the id and the username are returned, never an email address.
Returns a page of what has happened to the current user, newest first. A notification only exists while its recipient belongs to the group it is about, so nothing here needs filtering by access.

post.description: Opening the list is the act of having read it, so this marks all of the current user's unread notifications at once rather than one at a time.
Creates a chat with the current user as its first member. Everybody else has to be invited and accept.

query.description: Returns a page of the chats the current user belongs to or has been invited to, most recently active first, each with how many messages they have not read.

post.description: Anybody already in the chat may invite. The invited member has to accept before they are part of the conversation.

403.description: The invitation has not been accepted

404.description: No such chat, or no such user

409.description: Already invited or already in the chat

query.summary: List who is in a chat
query.description: Everyone in the chat, including those who have been invited and not yet accepted. Visible to anybody the chat is visible to — an invitation has to be able to see who it would be joining.

404.description: No such chat, or not one of the current user's

post.summary: Accept an invitation to a chat

404.description: No invitation to accept

delete.summary: Leave a chat, or decline an invitation to one
delete.description: The same act either way. The last member out takes the chat and its messages with them.

404.description: Not in that chat

query.description: Returns a page of messages, newest first. Paged by cursor rather than offset: messages arrive while somebody reads, and an offset would repeat or skip whatever crossed the boundary.

403.description: The invitation has not been accepted

404.description: No such chat, or not one of the current user's

201.description: The message as it was stored

403.description: The invitation has not been accepted

404.description: No such chat, or not one of the current user's

post.summary: Mark a chat as read up to now
post.description: Everything already sent counts as read. Unread is a comparison against this moment, not a receipt per message.

403.description: The invitation has not been accepted

404.description: No such chat, or not one of the current user's

query.summary: Search groups, threads and members at once
query.description: Runs one search across everything the current user may see and returns the matches grouped by kind, each with the total number found. Posts are not searched yet.
